verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal and compliance SaaS service, so offering scoped API credentials is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a public API, API keys, or permission scoping for agents. The documentation covers only dashboard access, document storage, filings and notifications, and the llms.txt probe offers crawler guidance rather than credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
